Class EventCard

java.lang.Object
it.polimi.ingsw.model.Cards.Card
it.polimi.ingsw.model.Cards.EventCard
All Implemented Interfaces:
TribeDeck
public class EventCard extends Card implements TribeDeck
Represents an Event Card in the game. It holds an EventEffect that is applied to the players when the event is resolved.

      public EventCard(String id, int era, int minPlayer, boolean isFinal, EventEffect eventEffect)
      Creates an EventCard.
      Parameters:
      id - the unique identifier of the card
      era - the era of the card
      minPlayer - the minimum number of players required for this card to be in the deck
      isFinal - true if this is a final event card, false otherwise
      eventEffect - the specific effect triggered by this event
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if eventEffect is null

      public void raiseEvent(List<Player> players, Game game)
      Resolves the event effect for the provided list of players.
      Parameters:
      players - the list of players participating in the event resolution
      game - the current game context used by the event effect
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if the players list is null
      IllegalStateException - if the players list is empty

    • isEvent

      public boolean isEvent()
      Description copied from interface: TribeDeck
      Helper discriminator method used to distinguish background events from interactable character assets without relying on unsafe reflection or instanceof checks.

      The default implementation returns false. Concrete event components must override this method to return true.

      Specified by:
      isEvent in interface TribeDeck
      Returns:
      true to indicate that this specific TribeDeck card is an event
